newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo rubber futures end mixed,eyes on China talks.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo rubber futures end mixed,eyes on China talks.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures ended mixed in lacklustre trade on Tuesday, as market players focused on reports that Thailand and China will soon agree on a deal for China to buy some Thai rubber, traders said.
Prices ranged from 0.4 yen per kg lower to 1.1 yen higher. Benchmark November was down 0.2 yen at 138.7 yen.
The market started firmer on short-covering in reaction to the yen's slight fall against the dollar, but buying ebbed amid a lack of fresh incentives.
"We are hoping that a China-Thailand rubber deal will provide support to the market," one trader said.
